# FlooringHub
> Direct-to-consumer and contractor flooring marketplace with local installation matching.

## Summary & Identity
- Website: https://flooringhub.vercel.app
- Vertical: Marketplace

## AI Agent & Machine Interface
- WebMCP Manifest: https://flooringhub.vercel.app/.well-known/mcp.json
- Full Documentation: https://flooringhub.vercel.app/llms-full.txt

## Interactive Tools & Capabilities (WebMCP)
- `calculate_flooring_estimate`: Calculate material requirements and cost estimate by square footage and material type
